long_biography.plain_text:
After studying Ancient Greek and earning an MBA at Columbia University, Ömer Mehmet Koç began in sales roles outside Turkey before joining companies within the family group. He progressed from finance coordinator to leadership of Koç Holding's energy businesses, later chairing Tüpraş and overseeing initiatives in refining capacity, efficiency and research. That record establishes an operating career within, rather than the creation of, the inherited enterprise.

Koç became chair of Koç Holding following years as a director and vice-chair. The conglomerate's roots and family ownership predate his career. His grandfather Vehbi Koç founded the business, and his father Rahmi Koç led its expansion before the chair passed to the next generation. Beyond corporate governance, Ömer Koç has held leadership roles at Koç University and the Vehbi Koç Foundation. His chairmanship of the Turkish Education Foundation further extends the family's institutional work in education, culture and social development.
